title: chunks
description: H1 unstructured vector index. Chunks reference turns by id only — text is derived from turns at embed time, never duplicated (ADR-0001). The embedding VECTOR is stored inline because brute-force cosine (D-021) must read the numbers; `embeddingRef`, a string pointer, could never be compared and is retired. Storing the vector is not a text duplication: it is a derived numeric artifact, not a second copy of the source.

chunkIndex.description: Position of this chunk within its session, so a re-index can be verified complete and ordered without re-deriving text.

vector.description: The embedding itself. minItems 1 because a zero-length vector has no direction: cosine against it is 0/0, so it would silently match nothing while the row looks populated (ISS-096).

dims.description: Length of `vector`. Stored rather than inferred so a mixed-model corpus is detectable by query instead of by a failed cosine — gemini-embedding-001 returns 3072, nomic-embed-text 768.

embeddingModel.description: Which model produced `vector`. Vectors from different models are not comparable, so this is what makes a mixed corpus diagnosable.
